The Government is searching for contractors who are able and interested in manufacturing the item(s) listed below.  AMC/AMSC (1/T).

The items are being bought to a Qualified Products List (QPL).  Competition for the parts are limited to sources which are listed on or are qualified for listing on the QPL at the time of award (see FAR part 9 and DFARS part 209).

Drawings can be downloaded by authorized users from the cFolders website via the Internet at https://pcf1.bsm.dla.mil/cfolders.  The drawings are available by doing a query for (SPE7LX26R0038) in the Solicitation field.  Problems with cFolders can be addressed by the cFolders Help Desk at (855) 352-0001 and/or via email at DSCC.ProdDataCustSvc@dla.mil.  Do not call the buyer for Drawing Item Issues.

Sources interested in offering on this solicitation should complete the attached market survey and spreadsheet and return the completed copies to Matthew Stein at Matthew.Stein@dla.mil by 03/23/2026.

We thank you in advance for your assistance.
